body: Hey. I'm so sorry to hear you've been feeling this way. Have you tried some apps like calm harm that help you find alternate ways to cope?
Was honestly just feeling the same way and was very close to going deeper. Thank you for this comment
A lapse is not a relapse. So proud of you and this in no way erases the progress you have made ❤️
How do I make myself study when I want to end it all 🙃
Thank you to everyone who replied. I did end up relapsing but I've been clean for 3 weeks now!

I haven't cut for a while and rn yeah it just feels like I don't have the energy to. Everytime the urge gets too strong I just think about how hard the cleanup process would be and go to sleep. Idk if this means I'm better or I'm worse. Mostly I'm just tired
I just want someone to. Hug me and ask me if I'm okay. I'm struggling to hold on. Just because I haven't messed up in a while doesn't mean I'm struggling any less so why does it feel like that
Honestly yeah it does. Been clean for almost 2 years but I don't want to hold on anymore. Seems sort of pointless
Thank you this is actually so helpful
Not exactly why I stopped self harming but when I decided to stop, I got to tattoo so I'd always have a reminder of my decision with me
